annotations.exact_quote: Matrix Completion for Cross-view Pairwise Constraint Propagation
annotations.reason_zh: 标题明确以跨视图成对约束传播为研究任务，扩展must-link/cannot-link监督关系。

annotations.exact_quote: With low rank requirement and graph regularization, our MCPCP can preserve local and global consistency simultaneously.
annotations.reason_zh: 方法显式引入低秩要求，将传播问题建模为低秩矩阵补全。

annotations.exact_quote: With low rank requirement and graph regularization, our MCPCP can preserve local and global consistency simultaneously.
annotations.reason_zh: 使用图正则化对学习结果施加几何一致性约束，以保持局部和全局一致性。

annotations.exact_quote: pairwise constraint propagation attracts more and more attention in semi-supervised learning
annotations.reason_zh: 论文在semi-supervised learning中利用成对约束作为有限监督信号指导传播。
跨视图设置表明同一对象有多个视图，并显式联合利用视图间成对约束关系。

annotations.exact_quote: we cast cross-view pairwise constraint propagation into a problem of low rank matrix completion
annotations.reason_zh: 将传播问题转化为低秩矩阵补全，估计缺失的成对约束矩阵元素并输出补全结果。
